construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: synthetic flag, ERP/MES work_order, customer, preferences, normalized-unit products, sensor_specs, embedded time-series telemetry_csv, quality_inspections, invented maintenance_logs, routing
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, stage, normalized context, cumulative stages
shared_schema.validation: validate_input normalizes and validates shared entities; validate_output revalidates context and recomputes cumulative deterministic stage contracts at every boundary; errors produce one JSON object and exit 2

cross_stage_handoffs.compare -> triage: Validated selected product and work-order identity create an accountable ticket with inspection evidence and telemetry alerts
cross_stage_handoffs.triage -> basic:onboard: Ticket identity, owner, selection and safety/quality hold determine the personalized next step
cross_stage_handoffs.basic:onboard -> interests: Validated discovery permission, customer interests and next step govern recommendation ranking and grounded explanations

behavior.comparison: Attribute normalization, side-by-side rows, weighted min-max utilities and stable product-ID tie breaks. Budget, asset compatibility and explicit ID/tag exclusions enforced before ranking. Equal metrics give all candidates full utility. Weights normalized by their sum.
behavior.triage: Configurable category priority and accountable owner; highest configured priority wins with quality/telemetry/procurement tie order; safety always overrides and requires critical human routing. All detections and original quality records retained.
behavior.onboarding: General-purpose profile, work-order and selection review progression personalized by name, experience and completed steps; safety/quality review blockers; no automated work authorization.
behavior.interests: 70% comparison score + 30% proportion of matching interests; rechecks exclusions, budget and asset; no recommendations during safety/quality hold; explanations contain only supplied attributes, matched interests and propagated next step.
behavior.industry_rules: Demonstrative ISO 9001-style quality-decision traceability only; required inspector/reason/timestamp/work-order/asset links, accepted measurements within tolerance, validated units and finite physical ranges, monotonic timezone-aware sensor readings. Not certification or operational safety guidance.
behavior.fixtures: Explicitly synthetic; telemetry drawn from bounded physically plausible ranges with random.Random(111); all IDs and maintenance logs invented.

included: quality trace and human safety escalation
synthetic ERP/MES JSON and embedded sensor CSV

cli.stdout: one validated JSON object with status ok and final stage interests
